revenue_scope: Kiniksa 'Product revenue, net' line (ARCALYST is Kiniksa's only product); excludes license and collaboration revenue, which Kiniksa prints as a separate line
geography: Product revenue line carries no geographic split; the FY2025 10-K revenue-by-customer-location note prints United States 676,750 of total revenue 677,564 (thousands), so the line is substantially U.S.

approval_evidence.quote: 02/27/2008 ORIG-1 Approval (BLA 125249, ARCALYST RILONACEPT 220MG VIAL; SINGLE-USE)

launch_evidence.quote: ARCALYST, which became commercially available through Kiniksa on April 1, 2021

series_start_reason: First quarter with an ARCALYST product revenue line: the 2021Q1 release has no product revenue line (ARCALYST became commercially available April 1, 2021); the 2021Q2 release prints 7,704 for three months and six months.
notes: Kiniksa prints 'Product revenue, net' separately from 'License and collaboration revenue' (FY2025 10-K: 2025 nil, 2024 6,210, 2023 37,083 thousands), so the product line used here excludes license revenue. Sum of 2023 quarters equals the printed 233,176 and of 2024 quarters 417,029; sum of 2021 Q2-Q4 equals 38,544 printed for 2021. The FY2025 10-K geographic note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730430/000110465926019168/knsa-20251231x10k.htm) prints United States 676,750, United Kingdom 814, Rest of world nil against total revenue 677,564 for 2025. A prior owner (Regeneron) reportedly printed its own U.S. ARCALYST net product sales for earlier periods; not extended here because that line is a different issuer and a narrower (CAPS-only) scope than Kiniksa's product revenue line, and Rule 11 allows joining only same-scope lines. Not verified in this repair pass.
